pr_title: Fix Tuya unsupported Temperature & Humidity Sensors (with or without external probe)
pr_body:
<!--

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

Tuya changed the category for some Temperature & Humidity Sensors from "wsdcg" to "qxj", yet again without announcement and not documented anywhere, very much like  #136960, It's possible they've created this new category for Temperature & Humidity Sensors with External Probe.

This PR fixes #136472 by adding the "qxj" category and adding the TEMP_CURRENT_EXTERNAL Data Point Code.
Because of that, I concider this PR partly bugfix/partly new feature (but mostly a bugfix).
Multiple users facing the issue have tested out the change and are fond with it (see the issue). 

Note: I'm getting some test-failures on missing translations. These are unrelated to my changes and were probably already existant. I've filed an issue, #138543

This seems to be yet another unannounced, undocumented category change by Tuya. (See #132844)

The category is supposed to be "wsdcg" from @darnoldser information, which is "Temperature and humidity sensor" according to [Tuya Developer Platform](https://developer.tuya.com/en/docs/iot/standarddescription?id=K9i5ql6waswzq)

I don't have the device to test it out myself, but I'm almost sure it's easily resolved as with the camera issue. I'll release a custom component with a fix I have in mind. If you would be so kind to test it for me, and we find it works perfectly, I can proceed with a PR.

I've added the custom repository, and downloaded the alpha release, when I go to add the integration it asks me for the "User Code" which I put in without any issues.
